# OreWire robots.txt
#
# This static copy is served by nginx as a safety net: /robots.txt is never
# proxied, so it cannot fail even if the backend renderer is unreachable.
# /sitemap.xml and /llms.txt ARE generated by the backend and proxied.
#
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# READ THIS BEFORE EDITING.
#
# robots.txt rules are NOT merged across groups. For any given crawler exactly
# ONE group applies: the most specific one matching its user-agent. Agent-specific
# groups are never combined with the `*` group. Google's spec: "only one group is
# valid for a given crawler... other groups are ignored"; RFC 9309 section 2.1.
#
# So `User-agent: Googlebot` followed by `Allow: /` and nothing else EXEMPTS
# Googlebot from every Disallow below, leaving /seo/, /api/ and /admin crawlable.
# That was a real defect in this file: the Disallow rules bound only `*`.
#
# The policy is identical for every crawler, so every crawler is listed as a
# consecutive `user-agent` line in ONE group. Repeating the user-agent line is how
# robots.txt applies one set of rules to many agents. The list below is
# deliberately unbroken — no comments or blank lines between the lines — because
# separator handling inside a group is the one place parsers have historically
# disagreed.
#
# If some agent ever needs a DIFFERENT policy, give it its own group AND repeat
# every Disallow line inside that group.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#
# Listed: GPTBot (OpenAI training), OAI-SearchBot (ChatGPT search),
# ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT browsing), PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, ClaudeBot,
# Claude-User, Claude-SearchBot, Google-Extended (Gemini), Applebot,
# Applebot-Extended (Apple Intelligence), DuckAssistBot, Amazonbot,
# meta-externalagent, cohere-ai, MistralAI-User, YouBot, CCBot (Common Crawl),
# Googlebot, Bingbot, Twitterbot, facebookexternalhit, LinkedInBot, Slackbot,
# and everything else via *.

User-agent: GPTBot
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
User-agent: PerplexityBot
User-agent: Perplexity-User
User-agent: ClaudeBot
User-agent: Claude-User
User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
User-agent: Google-Extended
User-agent: Applebot
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
User-agent: DuckAssistBot
User-agent: Amazonbot
User-agent: meta-externalagent
User-agent: cohere-ai
User-agent: MistralAI-User
User-agent: YouBot
User-agent: CCBot
User-agent: Googlebot
User-agent: Googlebot-Image
User-agent: Bingbot
User-agent: Twitterbot
User-agent: facebookexternalhit
User-agent: LinkedInBot
User-agent: Slackbot
User-agent: *

# One set of rules for every agent listed above.
Allow: /

# Private and authenticated surfaces: keep crawl budget on company profiles.
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /watchlist
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /change-password
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /auth/
# Internal QA renderer. Serves the same content as /company/<slug> without the
# canonical redirect, so it must never be indexed as a duplicate. This line was
# previously ineffective for every named crawler.
Disallow: /seo/
# Tracking parameters create duplicate URLs of pages already listed canonically.
Disallow: /*?*utm_
Disallow: /*?*fbclid=
Disallow: /*?*gclid=

Sitemap: https://www.orewire.com/sitemap.xml
